editorial:
You're on a train heading to Venice when a stunning stranger sits across from you and starts a conversation. That's exactly how Frank, an ordinary American tourist, meets Elise, a mysterious British woman with secrets. What starts as a charming romance quickly turns into a dangerous game of mistaken identity, as Frank gets pulled into a world of spies, mobsters, and police. The movie has a glamorous, old-school vibe that feels like a classic Hollywood thriller set against the beautiful canals of Venice.

Johnny Depp and Angelina Jolie bring serious star power, though their chemistry is more cool than fiery. The action scenes are light and fun rather than intense, and the pacing keeps things moving without rushing. Some viewers may find the plot a bit silly, but if you enjoy stylish escapism, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn that Frank is actually Alexander Pearce, the very man everyone has been hunting. Elise knew all along and was protecting him. Pearce hands over the stolen money to the police, clearing his name, and he and Elise sail away together on a boat. The twist reveals the whole movie was a clever game of deception, with the real criminal hiding in plain sight.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves glamorous spy thrillers and star-studded romance.
